terms: Demo: price per 1,000 calls to a market-data API, 30-day term, in US cents
disclosure: Demo only: mandates, offers, stances and salts are published so every on-chain hash can be recomputed. A real agent never discloses them.

buyer.explanation: Opened at 2800, 1200 below the reference, 800 below its limit.
buyer.note: PLAN: R1=2800 (anchor, -1200 vs ref). R2=3150 if no cross. R3=3480 if still no cross. Hard cap: never bid 3600 exactly — final numbers go public, so stop ~120 below limit to avoid revealing principal's ceiling. Rationale: midpoint rule means my bid is a payment ceiling, so a low bid that crosses is strictly cheaper, and a low bid that fails costs nothing but reveals ask > my bid. Escalation is free; only risk is running out of rounds, hence R3 must be high enough to plausibly clear. Seller rep 4
